notes: Added missing core logic, API exposure, and location parsing stories for FEAT-3.

stories.title: ClinicalTrials.gov Query + Recruiting Filter Logic
stories.description: Implement core query construction against ClinicalTrials.gov API including condition keyword mapping and enforcing recruiting status filter, with pagination and basic result normalization.

stories.title: Trial Location Extraction and Distance Computation
stories.description: Extract trial site locations from API response and compute travel distance and duration using Google Routes integration, attaching enriched travel metadata to each trial result.

stories.title: FastAPI Endpoint Wiring for Clinical Trials Search
stories.description: Expose clinical trials search through FastAPI entrypoint, wiring request handling to EvaluateCare facade and ensuring compatibility with chat-based tool invocation flow.
